hero.lede: Take a seat in chair 2. This is a mid skin fade, start to finish, seen from behind the chair. When you like it, book yours in two taps.

cut.body: Pick the height, the guard and the top. The mirror re-cuts it live, and the ticket spells it out the way your barber says it.

menu.title: Prices on the wall.
menu.body: Every cut ends with a hot towel and a neck shave. Tick what you want and see the total and when you'll be out the door.

items.name: Skin fade
items.desc: Foil to skin, blended up to the length you want on top

items.name: Taper
items.desc: Clean nape and sideburns, sides stay full

items.name: Scissor cut
items.desc: All scissors, for longer hair and curls

items.name: Buzz cut
items.desc: One guard all over, edged up

items.name: Beard trim + line-up
items.desc: Shape, guard work and a razor edge

items.name: Hot towel shave
items.desc: Two towels, pre-shave oil, straight razor

booking.body: Tap a time, then tap confirm. No account, no deposit. Cancel up to 2 hours before by text.
